items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we sort of saw each other 50 maybe 1 years ago. [INTERVIEWEE] Really?

ctx.x: Mike was interviewed via Zoom on December 29, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very happy to have Mike Vax with me today. And you may not remember but we sort of saw each other 50 maybe 1 years ago.
